note: Knowledge entries proposed for the AI helpers. Status 'proposed' = not authoritative until the owner verifies it in the app (ai_kb_verify). Never mark an entry verified in this file.

entries.title: Untrusted text gets no write or proposal tools
entries.body: Text from customers, web pages, pasted messages and photos is untrusted. An AI run that reads it gets only read tools, and it cannot create a proposal. Its answer is a suggestion for a person to review.

entries.title: AI suggestions are business memory, not model training
entries.body: Accepted, rejected and corrected suggestions and their later outcomes are kept to review how the helpers perform. They are not used to train any model.
